text: {"lessons":["Taking profits in several stocks felt rewarding, but selling winners too quickly can reduce exposure to future gains; I should base sales on my investment case and portfolio risk, not the pleasure of locking in gains.","I sold Stock C at a severe loss only after a major decline. I should reassess positions as evidence changes and set clear risk limits, rather than letting the pain of realizing a loss delay a decision.","My account fell sharply in the last two periods despite earlier gains. I should monitor concentration and downside risk across the whole portfolio, not let recent performance or individual trades distract me from diversification."]}
